parameters.name: area
parameters.description: Trimmed and NFC-normalized before validation; the normalized value must be non-empty and at most 128 UTF-16 code units. No raw-input maxLength is published.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Optional exact visible status.

parameters.name: If-None-Match
parameters.description: Conditional GET entity-tag list; a matching current strong ETag returns 304.

parameters.name: If-Match
parameters.description: Unsupported for this read; any supplied value returns 400 if-match-unsupported.

get.description: Returns a protected cursor page of incidents. Collection responses have no aggregate ETag and never return 304. Requires incidents.read (Viewer, Operator, Engineer, Administrator, or Auditor). If-None-Match is intentionally ignored for this collection and it never returns 304.

parameters.name: siteId
parameters.description: Optional canonical lowercase UUID-D Site filter.

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: Optional canonical lowercase UUID-D Device filter.

parameters.name: probeId
parameters.description: Optional canonical lowercase UUID-D Probe filter.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Optional exact incident status.

parameters.name: openedFrom
parameters.description: Optional inclusive UTC instant in yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss[.FFFFFFF]Z form.

parameters.name: openedTo
parameters.description: Optional inclusive UTC instant in yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss[.FFFFFFF]Z form; it must not precede openedFrom.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: OpenedAtDesc (default) or OpenedAtAsc.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Optional opaque protected cursor token, maximum 2,048 characters. Omission starts the query; an explicitly empty value is invalid. It is bound to this route, resource, filters, and sort.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Optional page size. Default is 50; accepted range is 1 through 200.

parameters.name: If-Match
parameters.description: Unsupported for this read; any supplied value returns 400 if-match-unsupported.

400.description: Problem Details with stable code (invalid-incident-query, if-match-unsupported, invalid-cursor, or cursor-filter-mismatch) and correlationId extension.

503.description: Problem Details with stable code (incident-read-unavailable) and correlationId extension.

post.description: Adds an immutable comment. Idempotency-Key and a current strong If-Match ETag are required. Requires incidents.operate (Operator or Administrator). Query parameters are forbidden. The request body accepts application/json case-insensitively with valid media-type parameters and has no additional JSON properties; unsupported media types return 400 invalid-content-type.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Canonical lowercase UUID-D incident identifier.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Required single canonical lowercase UUID-D key other than all-zero. It makes retries replay the original response.

parameters.name: If-Match
parameters.description: Required single current strong opaque incident ETag. Missing is 428; empty or OWS-only fields, malformed, weak, wildcard, comma-list, or repeated values are 400. The quoted empty strong opaque tag "" is syntactically valid and is evaluated as current or stale.

requestBody.description: Strict JSON request body; only the documented property is accepted.

ETag.description: Fresh result: the resulting current incident ETag. Exact idempotency replay: the stored original response ETag, returned without recomputation.

parameters.description: A comma-separated list of entity tags. Strong and weak tags use weak comparison; '*' is valid only as the sole member.

put.description: Stores a canonical IANA timezone or clears the retained preference row. If-Match is required for optimistic concurrency; identical values are idempotent no-ops.
